user.title: Connect to Nuvio TV
user.description: Enter the IP address and 4-digit pairing PIN shown under Settings -> Integrations -> Remote Control on your Nuvio TV.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Nuvio TV
reauth_confirm.description: The authentication token has expired or was regenerated on your TV. Enter the current 4-digit pairing PIN shown on your TV screen.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Nuvio TV. Check the IP and make sure Remote Control is enabled in TV Settings.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid pairing PIN. Check the PIN shown on your TV screen.

abort.already_configured: This Nuvio TV is already configured.
